metadata.description: Synthetic stand-in for a BIAN payments business domain.
Synthetic stand-in for a BIAN payment-initiation Service Domain: captures, validates, authorises and hands over customer payment instructions.
Synthetic stand-in for a BIAN payment-execution Service Domain: executes authorised instructions through schemes.
Synthetic stand-in for a BIAN party-authentication Service Domain: verifies a party's identity for a session or transaction.
The customer payment instruction the domain fulfils.
